content: Kà ilä abin, ntal a alɔŋki yàkyer alaar, yàmɛnà naa bà Elɛnit bàkäl anki un'sak anà bà Ɛbɛlyɔ ntɔn akweel adim aba bayɔbà anki taaŋ lanswà unsà nkääb a indiir a ilä a ilä.
Lalan Bàkwem Aŋiyweel bàtüüb ba un'kàbɔ a alɔŋki, waa bàtɛn a ba naa: « Kà yubwaŋ anki naa bi iwɛy ndaa a Nzam ntɔn mukab isaa adyà.
Abun, làsɔ̈ɔ̈l uboo a bɛ baar nsambwaar abye anà imbäl aŋàbwaŋ bàŋàyɔl a Dweelà anà an'yeerà, waa bi iyapà isal aki.
Ntɔn bi, bi iyàlab mupà taaŋ abi u ngyamàkà anà mulɔŋ Ndaa. »

Nköŋ yanswà yàkyey an'kyän amà: Ba bàsɔ̈ɔ̈l Ityen, mbuur aŋàyɔl a làkwikilà anà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, anà Filipo, Pɔlɔkɔr, Nikanɔr, Timɔnà, Palàmɛnas anà Nikɔlà un'nsi Antyɔsha kàbulà un'yudà unsà inzaam.
Ba baswɛŋ akà Antööm, Antööm bàyamà ntɔn ba, waa basi an'kɔɔ.
Apan, ndaa a Nzam yàpää aŋàsöönà. Ntal a alɔŋki yàbulà ya mbɔɔn a mbɔɔn u Yɛlusàlɛm, un'sɛŋ a angaŋ mbɔɔn kàläb làkwikilà.
Abun, Ityen kàkäl aŋàyɔl a kab a ngway anà ngwal, nde kàkyerà impà anà idiim a kölàköl uboo a un'sɛŋ.
Wɛɛ baar amwɛy uboo a baar a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà bàfabeelà naa asɔ aŋàtsuŋà, anà baar a Sirɛn anà Alɛksandri anà Silisi anà Azi, ba bàsɛmà musyeel mbaaŋ anà Ityen.
Wɛɛ ba bàkwe anki mutɔn an'yeerà anà Dweelà kàsyäälà nde mutɛn.
Ba bàpɛɛ baar nsɛm ntɔn ba bàtɛn naa: « Bi kan'wem, nde wàmubɛy Mɔsɛ anà Nzam. »
Apan, ba bàsiinà un'sɛŋ anà andweer anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn, waa bàyi, bàkör Ityen kà imbürà, waa bun'syen u làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl.
Akun, ba bun'twääl ambäl a loor bàtɛn naa: « Mbuur wà usàwɛy anki mutɛn ndaa a mbe akà ikal abi kyà in'kyɛɛl anà akà Un'kɔɔn.
Bi kàwem u mun ande naa Yɛsu, un'nazɔrya wà, ayàbwaab Ikal ki anà ayàsɔɔm nkääl abi kàsiwɛɛy Mɔsɛ. »
Apan baar banswà bàkäl mutsul nsaŋ u làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl, ileer aba byàkäl akà Ityɛn, ba bàmɛn ntabwey ande asànaa ntabwey a un'kyeey.
